correctness.rationale: Every normalized form, rank and eigenspace multiplicity follows from the exact centered-permutation Gram identity, the three irreducible character polynomials and their regular-representation central orthogonality. The 2-design claim follows from an irreducible two-sided group representation, while non-4-design follows from the strictly positive quadratic sampling kernel. Exact enumeration n=4..8 and independent full Gram diagonalization n=4..6 passed; no finite test is treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Centered Birkhoff vertices are a canonical highly symmetric spherical 2-design, but their precise nonlinear sampling stability is not fixed by second moments. The complete all-n evaluation spectrum reveals a cubic-dimensional invisible degree-two harmonic space, sharp nonzero conditioning and exact Specht multiplicities; this gives a natural full classification and an explicit boundary for using permutation-matrix designs in harmonic sampling rather than an arbitrary numeric exercise.
